description: Classes meet and join by intersecting and uniting representatives, complements use complements of representatives, and the two bound classes are the empty and full carrier classes.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.quotient_operations.{u} {α : Type u} (I : Order.Ideal (Set α))
  (A B : Set α) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk I A ⊓ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk I B =
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk I (A ∩ B) ∧
    Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk I A ⊔ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk I B =
        Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk I (A ∪ B) ∧
      (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk I A)ᶜ = Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk I Aᶜ ∧
        ⊥ = Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk I ∅ ∧
          ⊤ = Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk I Set.univ
